{"answer":{"pass":"findings","findings":[{"title":"Serves a stale receipt for an hour after its order changes","explanation":"The cache is keyed by order.id alone, so a refunded or edited order keeps returning the receipt rendered before the change until the entry expires.","lines":{"hunkId":"h_a2e0236601ffc778","side":"new","startLine":9,"line":11},"guidance":{"ref":"p1","effect":"raised"}},{"title":"Never evicts a receipt, so memory grows with every order viewed","explanation":"Expired entries are only replaced when the same order is read again; nothing deletes them, so the Map holds every receipt rendered since the process started.","lines":{"hunkId":"h_a2e0236601ffc778","side":"new","startLine":4,"line":4},"guidance":null}]}}

{"answer":{"pass":"steps","steps":[{"sentence":"`GET /orders/:id/receipt` sends the user's own order's receipt as plain text, or a 404","excerpts":[{"hunkId":"h_5c94b39812b2e8f8","side":"new","startLine":33,"line":40}]},{"sentence":"`renderReceipt` serves a cached receipt for an hour before rendering it again","excerpts":[{"hunkId":"h_a2e0236601ffc778","side":"new","startLine":8,"line":19}]},{"sentence":"The app config adds a receipt currency and footer","excerpts":[{"hunkId":"h_3822ea0f7192c70e","side":"new","startLine":31,"line":35}]}]}}
